instance.title: Instance Configuration
instance.description: Manage your Haven instance name, timezone, and display preferences.

backups.title: Backup Configuration
backups.description: Configure automated backups and Git-based remote storage.

fields.enabledDescription: Automatically create snapshots of the platform state

git.enabledDescription: Push each backup snapshot to a remote Git repository
git.noCredentialsWarning: Git is enabled but no credentials are selected. Backups not push to a remote repository until credentials are configured.

manual.title: Manual Backup
manual.description: Trigger an immediate backup snapshot outside the normal schedule.

restore.title: Restore from Backup
restore.description: Restore your platform state from a previous snapshot or Git commit.

manifest.description: Restore from the local manifests directory. Any changes you have made manually to the manifests folder will be applied to the database.

restore.noSelection: Select a snapshot or commit to restore.

preview.title: Preview Restore
preview.description: Review the changes that will be applied to your database. This action is irreversible.
preview.noChanges: No changes detected between the snapshot and the current state.
preview.successWithWarnings: Restore completed, but some managed-volume files could not be restored. Review the warnings below and check them manually.

configManifest.title: Configuration Manifest
configManifest.description: Edit the raw haven.yml configuration file. Changes are applied immediately to the running instance.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.description: Configure OpenTelemetry export to send Haven's metrics, traces, and logs to your own observability backend.
telemetry.disclaimer: Haven only sends telemetry data to the OTLP endpoint you configure here. No data is collected or shared with the Haven team.

fields.enabledDescription: Export metrics, traces, and logs via OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP)

dockerCleanup.title: Docker Cleanup
dockerCleanup.description: Periodically remove orphaned containers and unused images left behind by Haven, to reclaim disk space.

fields.enabledDescription: Run the cleanup job on a recurring schedule
fields.gracePeriodHoursDescription: Only remove containers/images that have been orphaned or unused for longer than this
fields.dryRunDescription: Log what would be removed without actually deleting anything

repositoryCleanup.title: Repository Cleanup
repositoryCleanup.description: Periodically remove dangling git repositories left behind by deleted services, to reclaim disk space.

fields.enabledDescription: Run the cleanup job on a recurring schedule
fields.gracePeriodHoursDescription: Only remove repositories that have been dangling for longer than this
fields.dryRunDescription: Log what would be removed without actually deleting anything

githubApp.title: GitHub App
githubApp.description: Configure the GitHub OAuth App used to connect GitHub accounts via OAuth.
githubApp.explanation: Haven authenticates with GitHub using a GitHub OAuth App that you register yourself, under your own GitHub account or organization's Developer Settings. Create one, then paste its Client ID and Client Secret below, and set the app's Authorization callback URL to the Redirect URI shown here. See the wiki for a full step-by-step guide.
githubApp.noDomainWarning: No external domain is configured for this instance yet, so a redirect URI can't be determined. Configure your instance's domain first.
githubApp.noDomainConfigured: Configure a domain to see the redirect URI

fields.clientSecretHelp: The client secret generated for your GitHub OAuth App.
fields.clientSecretKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current secret
fields.clientSecretKeepHelp: A secret is already configured. Leave this blank to keep it, or enter a new value to replace it.
fields.redirectUriHelp: Derived from your instance's configured domain. Paste this exact value into your GitHub OAuth App's Authorization callback URL field.
